declaration.mechanism_rationale: Replace only the public optimizer step rule. Fixed current BCAP relativistic loss, b_cap coefficient 1, zero interventions and noise, and constant schedule; task-owned auxiliary objectives remain active. Generator and encoder share the G-player normalization. Hybrid arms pin native-Adam groups to the incumbent base rate 0.00425; sampled-row arms consume actual rows and leave unsampled rows unchanged. This card is a reusable technique, not a task-specific optimizer.
